rows.behavior: When kmctl check fails, action/knowledge-ci.sh prints a GitHub ::error line to stdout that names kmctl check, says the reasons are on the run's summary page, and gives the link GITHUB_SERVER_URL/GITHUB_REPOSITORY/actions/runs/GITHUB_RUN_ID/attempts/GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT; the script still exits nonzero.
rows.fails_when: a run with a broken bundle and the GITHUB_* run variables set prints no ::error line, the line does not name kmctl check, or the link is missing or wrong, or the script exits 0

rows.behavior: When kmctl review due crashes, the script prints the same kind of ::error line naming kmctl review due, with the same link.
rows.fails_when: a run whose kmctl review due crashes prints no ::error line naming kmctl review due, or the link is missing

rows.behavior: A passing run prints no ::error line, and outside GitHub (no GITHUB_SERVER_URL, GITHUB_REPOSITORY or GITHUB_RUN_ID) a failing run still prints the ::error line, pointing at the summary without a broken link.
rows.fails_when: a passing run prints ::error, or a failing run without the run variables prints a link with empty parts or no ::error line
rows.command: uv run pytest -q packages/kmctl/tests/test_action.py -k 'no_error_line_when_passing or error_line_without_run_url'

rows.behavior: The how-to that installs the Action says a failed check names the failed command in the log and links the summary page.
rows.fails_when: docs/how-to/install-the-plugin-and-the-ci-action.md does not mention the summary link in the log
